title: finance.chart
description: Get a historical price series for a tracked symbol over a fixed span, fetched live from Yahoo Finance's chart endpoint. Unlike finance.history (which replays the node's passively-accumulated poll samples), this surface fetches real upstream OHLC so the detail-page chart works on a fresh install and over spans longer than the 90-day retention window. Symbols outside the tracked list return MeshDeny: finance_untracked_symbol. Returns { symbol, range, points: [{ t, close, volume }] } oldest-first.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol (case-insensitive, normalised to uppercase by the handler). Must be in the node's tracked list.

range.description: Chart span (shortest → longest). Default '1M' if omitted. Intraday intervals are used for 1D/5D, daily bars for 1M/3M/1Y.
